recipes.oracle_text: Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn. You may tap any number of untapped Vampire creatures you control. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those Vampires.

recipe_coverage: Declared stat reduction and coupled effects only; extra abilities, alternate costs and restricted branches need independent cases. Witnesses are non-Vampires/non-Cyclopes with no counters; no creature died before casting.
